content:
alex: Hey - staging `terraform apply` got stuck mid-apply and now plan shows a tainted k8s deployment and an import mismatch. Anyone seen a pattern like this?
Priya: Which workspace/stack? Logs?
alex: staging/us-west-2 - attaching the last bit of the `terraform apply` output:
```
2026-03-16T20:11:07Z [apply] starting apply
2026-03-16T20:11:12Z [runtime] kv_cache_warmup: prefix_cache=0.012s
2026-03-16T20:11:13Z [k8s] reading deployment "api-main": observed replicas=3, desired=5
2026-03-16T20:11:14Z ERROR: apply interrupted: state lock lost (dynamodb://tf-state-locks/staging)
Error: provider kubernetes: failed to read Deployment.api-main: 409 Conflict
```
Priya: hm - state lock lost then kubernetes read conflict. Maybe someone restarted the apply on a different runner? Who had the lock?:
sre-bot: lock table entry:
  holder: ci-runner-42
  acquired_at: 2026-03-16T20:10:58Z
  expires_at: 2026-03-16T20:11:28Z
morgan: Also note we rotated SOPS KMS key yesterday for `secrets/api-creds`. If the secret changed in cluster, the k8s provider might see different manifest sha -> taint.
alex: Good call. The secret was updated by the rotations job right before apply.
Priya: Quick checks: 1) is the dynamodb lock still present? 2) what does `terraform state show module.api.kubernetes_deployment.this` return? 3) `kubectl get deploy api-main -o yaml | yq .spec.replicas`
alex: Dynamo lock is gone now. `terraform state show` errors with "resource not found in state" and `kubectl` shows replicas=3.
morgan: That explains the plan suggesting recreate/taint: state thinks desired=5 (from TF code) but cluster has 3. If secret rotation mutated the manifest hash annotation, TF's kubernetes provider will try to replace.
Priya: Fix options (pick one):
• run `terraform import module.api.kubernetes_deployment.this default/api-main` to sync cluster->state, then `terraform plan`.
• or adjust replicas in code to 3 temporarily, apply, then revert.
• if the lock was orphaned but someone still holding it, coordinate - don't force-delete unless you confirm.
alex: I tried `terraform import` but it failed earlier with provider auth error during apply; maybe the runner lost K8s creds while caching warmed up. Trying import again now.
deploy-bot: reminder: avoid manual dynamodb deletes during office hours for staging; ping #eng-sre if you need escalation :warning:
morgan: If import works, do a `plan -out=sync.tfplan` then `apply sync.tfplan` to avoid another mismatch sync.
alex: Looks like import succeeded this time. Re-running plan. Will update.
Priya: Thanks. If plan still shows replace, grab the kubernetes provider debug log and paste. Might be a manifest hash annotation issue from SOPS change.
alex: Will do. :thumbsup:
